note: Both sets misread the suppression condition '2e-11' as '11-star' and contain misbound table values (assigning values from wrong charge columns). Set A incorrectly attributes TRL 5 to the VVC (text specifies HLC), while Set B correctly identifies HLC as the backup. Set B is overly fragmented regarding the optical path (4 claims for one sequence), but avoids Set A's substantive TRL entity error.
remarks: Both extractors struggle with the '2e-11' scientific notation, reading it as '11-star'. Both also confuse table columns for aberration sensitivities. Set B's fragmentation of the optical path into multiple claims is inefficient but not factually wrong, whereas Set A's TRL claim is a direct contradiction of the text.
